message.content:
Here's a short, fun, and inspiring goodbye message for Stephen:

---

**Subject: The Meme Lord Departs 🎤⬇️**

Hey team,

Today we bid farewell to Stephen, the engineer who could debug production faster than he could drop a meme in #general—and *boy*, did he drop memes.

Stephen, you didn't just write clean code; you wrote *legendary* code. While the rest of us were still reading Stack Overflow, you were already three commits ahead and celebrating with a perfectly timed "This is fine" dog meme.

The repo will miss your pull requests. Slack will miss your GIF game. We'll all miss the guy who could turn a 3-hour outage into a 10-minute fix *and* make us laugh about it after.

Go forth and build amazing things, Stephen. May your builds always pass, your latency stay low, and your meme folders stay forever stocked. 

The server room dims a little tonight. 🖥️✨

*Don't be a stranger—our DMs are always open (and yes, we expect memes).*

**#StephenSigningOff #OneOfTheGreats #MemeEngineer**

---
